en: Sepia-toned interior view of an old pharmacy or apothecary. The room is filled with ornate wooden cabinets and drawers, each with metal label holders, and shelves lined with glass jars and bottles. There is a large decorative counter, an elaborate early cash register, balance scales, apothecary jars on the work surface, and a classical bust on top of a cabinet. Floral wallpaper borders the upper wall, and hanging lamps descend from the ceiling. The overall style is late 19th–early 20th century European.
